"""Customer segmentation for the account managers' report."""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Customer:
    name: str
    city: str
    plan: str
    monthly_spend: float


def group_by_city(customers):
    groups = {}
    for customer in customers:
        groups.setdefault(customer.city, []).append(customer)
    for members in groups.values():
        members.sort(key=lambda c: c.name)
    return dict(sorted(groups.items()))


def group_by_plan(customers):
    groups = {}
    for customer in customers:
        groups.setdefault(customer.plan, []).append(customer)
    for members in groups.values():
        members.sort(key=lambda c: c.name)
    return dict(sorted(groups.items()))


def top_spenders(customers, limit=3):
    ranked = sorted(customers, key=lambda c: c.monthly_spend, reverse=True)
    return [c.name for c in ranked[:limit]]
